method: ARRIVAL (explicit | implicit | negative) x SIZE the idea turns out to be (Large | Medium | Tiny | Bug). Positives are new ideas, vague requests and spec drafts before any plan exists; negatives are the doors next to it: a bug with a reproduction (bugfix), a plan already accepted (plan), status (status), opening an issue (issue-contract).
